material_facts.fact: Direct dispute concerned solely a courthouse judgment
Bank directed consumer to the reporting source

determinations.rationale: Under 12 CFR 1022.43, furnishers need not investigate direct disputes concerning solely public records. The judgment-only dispute falls within that exception, so the direct-dispute duty is not applicable and is satisfied. The bank also directed the consumer to the proper source.
